description: Step 1 of 2: nothing is charged. Prices a variant of a ready video: translate (languages), reformat (aspect ratios, recomposed not cropped), recreate (new takes with the same settings, or another pace, the project's code screens and Brand Kit included, priced like the web app's Recreate) or export_4k. Returns a quote_id for confirm_operation.

pace.description: recreate: the new takes' pace, calm (Calm), normal (Balanced) or fast (Punchy), e.g. a calmer take of a film that feels too fast. Default: the project's (its pick, else its goal's). Same price.

visibility.description: Default: the same as the source video (recreate: the project's choice if it made one; a project made from code starts private).

voice_id.description: translate: a voice from get_options (default: the video's voice when it is a native speaker of the language, else a native voice of the language).

name: request_variant
title: Prepare a variant (quote)
